_note: Generated by `npm run balance -- --defis --games 1000 --search 100`: for each Défi, how the simulated owners' games ended, for « Mieux que N % des parties simulées ». `brokenShare` is the share of the games that broke one of the Défi's conditions; `values` holds what the goal's `metric` measured in the others at each of the percentiles, in increasing order of the value, null if every game broke one. A game that broke a condition ranks below every other. So a game that broke none is better than N = 100 × (brokenShare + (1 − brokenShare) × p / 100) % of them, where p is the percentile of its value among `values` read as `percentileOf()` reads percentiles.json (0 below the lowest, the highest percentile at or above the highest, linear in between); for `spoilageRate`, where lower is better, p is 100 minus that. A game that broke a condition is better than none. Do not edit by hand: run the command again, and commit this file with docs/balance/phase-3.md, after any change to the engine or the content that moves the numbers.
